_comment_div_factor: Scaling factor for diversity bonus. Higher = more diversity pressure
_comment_div_factor_decay: Decay rate for div_factor over training. 1.0 = no decay
_comment_gamma: Temporal discounting for JSD computation. Controls trajectory vs action-level diversity.
_comment_gamma_values: gamma=1.0: trajectory-level (sensitive), gamma=0.0: action-level (stringent), gamma=0.5: balanced

for_simple_environments.comment: Tight solution spaces benefit from trajectory-level diversity

for_complex_environments.comment: Environments with action nullspaces need stringent action-level diversity
